toxicMaterial.name: Datura stramonium poison
toxicMaterial.description: A plant-associated toxic material containing tropane alkaloids such as atropine and scopolamine. Concentration varies among tissues and exposure contexts.
toxicMaterial.ecologicalRoleSummary: The ecological role of the alkaloids is treated conservatively as unresolved in this dossier.

components.summary: Alkaloids associated with anticholinergic toxicity after ingestion.
